_meta.note: The sowing advisory's strings, merged over layer zero's pack at load. Every key starts with `sowing.`; `sowing.crop.*` are crop names, said in the reader's language inside a message.

strings.sowing.no_probe: No sowing advice for {crop} in {bed}: it has no soil temperature probe within {depth:.0f} cm of the surface.
strings.sowing.unseen: No sowing advice for {crop} in {bed}: its soil temperature probe has sent nothing for {hours:.0f} hours.
strings.sowing.never_seen: No sowing advice for {crop} in {bed}: its soil temperature probe has sent nothing yet.
strings.sowing.untrusted: No sowing advice for {crop} in {bed}: its soil temperature readings failed the health checks ({flags}).
strings.sowing.too_new: No sowing advice for {crop} in {bed} yet: its soil temperature probe has been reading for less than a day.
strings.sowing.cold: Not yet for {crop} in {bed}: the soil at {depth:.0f} cm has averaged {mean:.1f} °C over the last three days, and the seed needs at least {min:.0f} °C to germinate.
strings.sowing.hot: Too warm for {crop} in {bed}: the soil at {depth:.0f} cm has averaged {mean:.1f} °C over the last three days, and above {max:.0f} °C the seed barely germinates.
strings.sowing.good: Good soil for sowing {crop} in {bed}: {mean:.1f} °C at {depth:.0f} cm over the last three days, within the seed's best range of {lo:.0f} to {hi:.0f} °C.
strings.sowing.good_days: Good soil for sowing {crop} in {bed}: {mean:.1f} °C at {depth:.0f} cm over the last three days, within the seed's best range of {lo:.0f} to {hi:.0f} °C. Seedlings in about {days:.0f} days.
strings.sowing.cool: Sown in {bed} now, {crop} would come up slowly: the soil at {depth:.0f} cm has averaged {mean:.1f} °C, below the seed's best range of {lo:.0f} to {hi:.0f} °C.
strings.sowing.cool_days: Sown in {bed} now, {crop} would come up slowly: the soil at {depth:.0f} cm has averaged {mean:.1f} °C, below the seed's best range of {lo:.0f} to {hi:.0f} °C. Seedlings in about {days:.0f} days.
strings.sowing.warm: Sown in {bed} now, {crop} would come up, but less well: the soil at {depth:.0f} cm has averaged {mean:.1f} °C, above the seed's best range of {lo:.0f} to {hi:.0f} °C.
strings.sowing.warm_days: Sown in {bed} now, {crop} would come up, but less well: the soil at {depth:.0f} cm has averaged {mean:.1f} °C, above the seed's best range of {lo:.0f} to {hi:.0f} °C. Seedlings in about {days:.0f} days.
